title: WE BUILD - Membership Credential - SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of a Membership Credential as defined in the rb-ds-membership Rulebook (Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing, aligned with the catalog baseline of HAIP draft-03 and SD-JWT VC draft -09.

identifier.description: An identifier together with the scheme it belongs to. SD-JWT VC form of the typed literal described in Rulebook Section 2.2.3; the W3C VCDM encoding uses {"@type", "@value"}. Where no scheme from code list 2.8 applies, a plain string.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme, published as a named individual by the European Business Wallet Vocabulary. See Rulebook code list 2.8.

value.description: The identifier value, in the scheme given by scheme.

oneOf.description: Untyped identifier, used where the scheme has no individual published in the vocabulary (for example the KMG-MID used by the DADS platform).

evidenceEntry.description: One identification means presented by, or verified for, the holder during the initial onboarding process. See Rulebook Section 2.6.1.

identifier.description: The identifier by which the holder's identity was proven during onboarding.

economicOperator.description: An economic operator, identified by its legal name and an identifier. See Rulebook Section 2.2.3.

legalName.description: Official legal name of the economic operator.

legalIdentifier.description: The stable, EU-level identifier. Scheme is Euid or PublicSectorBodyId (range of the legalIdentifier property). Used by member.

identifier.description: A further identifier of the economic operator, in any scheme from code list 2.8. Used by onboardedBy.operator.

iss.description: Issuer identifier. For the SD-JWT VC profile this is normally the onboarding service provider HTTPS URL.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp as a JWT NumericDate.

nbf.description: Not-before timestamp as a JWT NumericDate, where used.

exp.description: Expiration timestamp as a JWT NumericDate.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type for the Membership Credential.

attestation_legal_category.description: Legal category of the attestation. In EBWV v0.1, EAA denotes the non-qualified Electronic Attestation of Attributes category.

id.description: DID of the credential subject. May change, in contrast to member.legalIdentifier. DS-specific name retained for interoperability.

member.description: The holder of the credential, as an economic operator. member.legalIdentifier carries the stable, EU-level identifier; for the MVP this re-uses the EUID from the holder's EUBWOID. DS-specific name retained for interoperability.

memberOf.description: DSI or dataspace membership value. An absolute IRI registered in Rulebook code list 2.8, under the owning DSI's or dataspace's own domain. The memberOf property is typed @id in the European Business Wallet Vocabulary, so the value is an IRI and not a plain label.

holderIdentifier.description: Stable and unique identifier used within the DSI or dataspace to refer to THE HOLDER. Populated only where it differs from member.legalIdentifier. Subject to integrity rules IR-06 and IR-07.

role.description: The roles the holder has within the DSI or dataspace. Each value is an absolute IRI; those registered in Rulebook code list 2.8 are the DataSpaceRole individuals under https://w3id.org/ebwv#. A DSI may mint further role IRIs under a namespace it owns. A single role may appear as a scalar rather than a one-element array; both forms are accepted. See Rulebook Section 3.3.1.

termsOfUse.description: Dataspace governance rulebook information. See Rulebook Section 2.2.1.

url.description: Reference to the online dataspace governance rulebook.

version.description: Version of the online rulebook at the time of acceptance.

hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the rulebook, represented as 64 hexadecimal characters.

acceptedAt.description: Datetime when the rulebook was accepted, where present. Subject to integrity rule IR-01.

onboardedBy.description: The platform through which the holder was onboarded: the platform itself and the economic operator hosting it. Describes the onboarding party only; how the holder was identified is recorded in evidence. See Rulebook Section 2.2.2.

platformId.description: DID identifying the platform through which the holder was onboarded.

name.description: Commercial name of the platform (DSI or onboarding partner).

operator.description: The economic operator hosting and running the platform. Its identifier identifies that organisation, NOT the holder.

evidence.description: The identification means used to prove the holder's identity during the initial onboarding process. Describes the HOLDER, never the platform or its operator. Subject to integrity rules IR-03 and IR-04. A single entry may appear as an object rather than a one-element array; both forms are accepted. See Rulebook Sections 2.6.1 and 3.3.1.

status_list_credential.description: URI of the Status List Credential that contains the status bitstring.

status_list_index.description: Zero-based index into the status list bitstring for this credential.

cnf.description: Confirmation claims per SD-JWT VC. Used when the credential is holder-bound.

jwk.description: Public key bound to the holder.
